seoTitle: Illinois School Calendar 2026-2027: Start Dates, Holidays, Breaks & District Calendars
seoDescription: Find Illinois school calendars for 2026-2027, including district start dates, holidays, winter break, spring break, emergency days, PDFs, and Google Calendar downloads.
about:
Illinois public school calendars are approved locally by each school district, so first day of school, winter break, spring break, parent-teacher conference days, teacher institute days, professional development days, e-learning days, and emergency day schedules can vary by community. Large districts such as Chicago Public Schools publish detailed family calendars with K-12 dates, preschool dates, holidays, report-card dates, and other planning notes.

Illinois families should use district calendars as the source of record for school-year planning. Calendar details can differ between districtwide dates and school-specific events, especially for testing, athletics, graduation ceremonies, program calendars, and emergency make-up days. MySchoolDates organizes available Illinois district calendar pages and links back to official district sources for verification.

Illinois State Board of Education guidance and local board approval processes can affect how districts describe attendance days, emergency days, institute days, and remote or e-learning plans. Districts may reserve emergency days near the end of the school year or use approved e-learning days when weather or other closures disrupt instruction, so families should verify final dates before making June travel or childcare plans.

faqs.a: Illinois school start dates vary by district. Many districts begin in August, while some calendars extend into early September. Select a district calendar below to confirm the official first day of school.

faqs.q: When does school start in Illinois in 2026?
faqs.a: Illinois does not have one statewide first day of school. Most large public school districts start in August, but the official 2026 start date must be verified on each local district calendar.

faqs.q: Are Illinois school calendars the same statewide?
faqs.a: No. Illinois public school calendars are approved locally, so first day, last day, breaks, professional development days, and emergency day schedules can differ by district.

faqs.q: When is Illinois winter break in 2026?
faqs.a: Illinois winter break dates vary by district. Many calendars place winter break in late December and early January, but families should check the specific district calendar for exact dates.

faqs.q: Do Illinois schools have Presidents Day off?
faqs.a: Some Illinois districts close for Presidents Day while others may schedule attendance, institute, or professional development days differently. Check the district calendar before assuming it is a student holiday.

faqs.q: How many school days are required in Illinois?
faqs.a: Illinois districts must meet state attendance requirements, but local calendars may describe instructional days, institute days, emergency days, and e-learning days differently. Families should use the official district calendar for the student attendance schedule.

faqs.q: Where can I find the CPS calendar?
faqs.a: Use the Chicago Public Schools calendar page on MySchoolDates for CPS first day, last day, holidays, breaks, parent-teacher conference days, printable PDF, and ICS download options.

faqs.q: Do Illinois districts use emergency days?
faqs.a: Many Illinois district calendars include emergency day or make-up day notes. Families should verify the final calendar with the official district source before making June plans.

faqs.q: What are teacher institute days on Illinois school calendars?
faqs.a: Teacher institute days are staff-focused days that may appear on Illinois district calendars as student non-attendance days. The exact dates and labels vary by district.

faqs.q: Do Illinois schools use e-learning days?
faqs.a: Some Illinois districts reference e-learning or remote learning days as part of their closure or emergency-day plans. Check the district's official calendar and announcements for how those days are used.

faqs.q: Can I add an Illinois school calendar to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. District pages on MySchoolDates include calendar download options when available, including ICS files that can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.
